attchmntText: Whirlpool of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Schedule of meet
voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited has scheduled a conference call for investors and analysts to discuss financial results for the quarter ended September 30, 2026. The call is set for Thursday, 19th November 2026, at 04:30 PM IST. Management representatives include Arvind Uppal, Narasimhan Eswar, Aditya Jain, and Sweta Srivastava. The call leader is Deepak Agarwal from Axis Capital. The investor presentation will be submitted to stock exchanges before the call and made available on the company and exchange websites. Discussions will rely on publicly available information, with no unpublished price sensitive information shared. The schedule is subject to change due to exigencies.

attchmntText: Whirlpool of India Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited filed a notice with BSE Limited and the National Stock Exchange of India Limited on 10th November 2026. The filing pertains to the newspaper advertisement regarding financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The advertisements were published in the Financial Express and the Pune edition of Loksatta on that date. The information is also hosted on the company website at www.india.whirlpool.in. The notice was signed by Sweta Srivastava, Company Secretary and Compliance Officer.

attchmntText: Whirlpool of India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release dated November 09, 2026, titled "KEY HIGHLIGHTS OF Q2 2026-27".
voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited filed a press release regarding unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. Consolidated revenue from operations was Rs 1873 Cr, representing a 14% year-on-year increase. Consolidated EBITDA stood at Rs 40 Cr with a margin of 2.1%, which was lower by 140 basis points compared to the previous year. Consolidated profit before tax was Rs 34 Cr, a margin of 1.8%, lower by 110 basis points versus the previous year. The company launched the Luxuriem refrigerator range. Profitability faced headwinds from commodity inflation, crude oil price increases, and currency depreciation. An additional price increase of approximately 5% was implemented effective November 1, 2026. Subsidiary Elica India reported a 12% revenue increase and a 22% profit before tax increase for the quarter.

attchmntText: Whirlpool of India Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Whirlpool of India Limited announced the outcome of its Board Meeting held on 09th November, 2026. The Board approved the Unaudited Financial Results, both Standalone and Consolidated, for the quarter and half year ended on 30th September, 2026. The meeting commenced at 09:00 AM and concluded at 04:05 PM. A Limited Review Report was provided by M/s. S.R. Batliboi & Co. LLP, the Statutory Auditors. The extracts of the financial results will be published in Financial Express and the Pune edition of Loksatta on or before 11th November, 2026. Full financial results are available on www.nseindia.com, www.bseindia.com, and www.india.whirlpool.in.
